CUDA_memory_scope: nvidia-smi used_gpu_memory for GPU0 processes in the child-owned PGID/SID; includes CUDA context/allocator. This is sampled physical process memory, not a hard allocation reservation or only Torch allocated tensors.
host_memory_scope: Sum of resident pages in child-owned PGID/SID; shared pages can be counted per process. Exact wait4 peak RSS is separately retained.
bounded_stop_signal: SIGKILL only after child PID/startticks/PGID/SID identity recheck
